project.name: ReviewBot
project.description: Open-source, self-hosted, model-agnostic AI code review bot for GitHub pull requests

bugs.bug: ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND when running compiled server: package.json exports pointed to src/index.ts instead of dist/index.js
bugs.fix: Pointed exports to dist/index.js across all monorepo packages

bugs.bug: ERR_SQLITE_ERROR unable to open database file when ./data directory does not exist
bugs.fix: Added recursive fs.mkdirSync for parent directory in ReviewDatabase constructor

rules: BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) — no vendor lock-in on LLM provider
GitHub App as primary integration, GitHub Action as secondary
All code review logic must be model-agnostic
Stage F finding validation: drop hallucinated files and unanchored lines before posting to GitHub
Anti-prompt-injection: wrap untrusted diffs in XML tags and forbid following commands within code comments
Deterministic secret scanning: scan added lines for credentials and flag as critical before LLM inference
Pre-LLM secret redaction: scrub detected tokens and keys from prompt payload to protect credentials
Diff size budget guards: enforce max 50 files and playground payload caps

components.name: @reviewbot/diff
components.description: Unified diff parser, file stat extraction, and line-in-hunk anchor verification

components.name: @reviewbot/config
components.description: Zod-validated .reviewbot.yaml loader, path filtering with picomatch, and path-specific review instructions

components.name: @reviewbot/llm
components.description: Provider-neutral LLM client with OpenAICompatibleProvider (OpenAI, Ollama, DeepSeek, Groq) and MockLLMProvider

components.name: @reviewbot/review-core
components.description: Core review engine orchestrator, prompt builders, and Stage F finding validator

components.name: @reviewbot/github
components.description: HMAC-SHA256 webhook signature verifier, Octokit GitHub App installation client, and markdown/suggestion formatter

components.name: @reviewbot/persistence
components.description: SQLite storage using Node.js built-in node:sqlite for delivery deduplication, job tracking, and finding fingerprint deduplication

components.name: @reviewbot/server
components.description: Fastify HTTP webhook server (/health, /api/webhooks/github) with bounded in-process review worker

decisions.decision: Research phase — analyzed CodeRabbit architecture, alternatives (PR-Agent, Kodus, Pullfrog), GitHub App integration requirements
Project naming: ReviewBot with .reviewbot.yaml config and @reviewbot/* packages
decisions.rationale: User confirmed preference aligned with Codex plan specification

decisions.decision: Persistence via Node.js native node:sqlite DatabaseSync
decisions.rationale: Zero external build tools or C++ compilation issues on Windows, single-file SQLite database

decisions.decision: In-process bounded queue worker rather than external Redis/BullMQ
decisions.rationale: Simplicity first for self-hosting; keeps deployment footprint lean

log.details: Researched CodeRabbit internals (codegraph, agentic pipeline, sandboxed execution, AST analysis), existing open-source alternatives, GitHub App webhook/permissions model, pricing gaps to exploit

Implemented full monorepo with 6 packages and Fastify server. Added diff parser with hunk validation, config loader, LLM provider, review engine with Stage F validation, GitHub App webhook verifier/formatter, SQLite persistence, docker-compose and .env.example. All 7 Vitest test suites (20 tests) passing.
Fixed package exports resolution for compiled Node ESM runtime. Added auto-creation of SQLite database directory. Verified server startup on port 3000 and /health endpoint.

Successfully received live webhook on PR #1, authenticated as GitHub App, ran LLM review with Gemini 3.1 Pro High, ran Stage F finding validation, and posted review summary + 2 line comments with suggestion block to https://github.com/pranav6004/reviewbot/pull/1#pullrequestreview-5407203318.
Created run.bat script that auto-frees port 3000, starts smee webhook tunnel in a separate window, and launches the server.

Implemented dark mode Control Center UI at http://localhost:3000/ with live stats, review feed, interactive diff review playground, and .reviewbot.yaml config schema validator. Tested all REST endpoints end-to-end.

Implemented 4-layer security guardrail system: 1) Deterministic pre-LLM secret scanning for AWS, GitHub PATs, JWTs, private keys, and Slack tokens; 2) Pre-LLM credential redaction from prompt text; 3) Anti-prompt-injection isolation tags (<pull_request_context> & <untrusted_diff>) with system instruction hardening; 4) Diff file/byte budget guards and 250KB playground payload limits. Added 4 unit tests (24/24 passing).

Pivoted brand completely away from rabbit/animal tropes to eliminate trademark confusion. Purged rabbit emojis from UI and runner. Built 3 original developer marks: 1) The Hex Prism (optical code aperture), 2) The Merge Shield (PR gatekeeper), 3) The Vector R (topological monogram). All 3 marks scored 99-100/100 production readiness.

User selected Concept 1 (Hex Prism) and Concept 2 (Merge Shield). Built developer mockup presentation with 6 software surfaces (GitHub README, Terminal, App Icon, Website, Sticker, Social). Synthesized Concept 3 (Hex Shield Hybrid) combining hexagonal aperture with verification checkmark.

Audited git history: confirmed zero committed .env or .pem secrets. Hardened .gitignore for open-source (blocked .env.*, *.pem, *.key, *.p12, *.sqlite, data/, logs/). Locked in Concept 1 (The Hex Prism), exported full production web-icon kit (favicon.ico, apple-touch-icon, icon-192/512, webmanifest, monochrome SVGs), and mounted into dashboard UI and README.

Added official Apache 2.0 LICENSE file. Rewrote README.md into an exhaustive, production-grade open-source document featuring SVG brand banner, shields/badges, comparison matrix vs commercial SaaS, 7-stage pipeline diagram, Control Center dashboard tour, GitHub App permission tables, local runner guide, and .reviewbot.yaml specification.

Streamlined README.md from 300 lines to a punchy, clean 100-line overview (removed overshared internal pipeline specs). Terminated lingering background task-805 which was causing queued messages. Pushed clean README to main and test/ai-review-test.
Purged residual rabbit emoji from packages/github/src/formatter.ts, rebuilt all workspace dist bundles, and added automatic localhost:3000 browser launch to run.bat.

Executed full formal security audit on ReviewBot using security-audit skill. Mapped architecture, evaluated 10 attack classes across 5 subsystems, validated coverage-ledger.json (10 units PASS) and findings.json (3 confirmed findings PASS). Identified webhook fail-open condition, unauthenticated playground LLM quota exhaustion, and telemetry repository disclosure. Generated complete report artifacts in security-audit-run/.
